quantity: median water-equivalent lateral path through the trunk
note: No citable water-equivalent thickness for a lateral lumbar projection exists. The nearest published statement is that rolling a patient from lateral decubitus onto their back adds 2-9 cm of traversed tissue (PMID 23652542). This is measured directly on CT.

quantity: photons per render pixel arriving at the detector
note: 10-70 nGy/frame measured on a Siemens Cios Alpha mobile C-arm (PMID 30339271), converted at 34.2 photons/mm2/nGy over this pixel. The simulator is not fitted to this.

Measured on anthropomorphic AP and lateral abdomen phantoms, where the 95th percentile of the 2-D scatter-to-primary map ran 42 to 185 per cent above its median (PMID 38942002). Compared within one 9-inch field, because that is the region a real measurement covers.

quantity: nearest-neighbour noise correlation at this pixel size
note: A real fluoroscopic panel measures r(1)=0.20 at its own 194 um pitch (PMID 24593724); binning to this render pixel should leave 0.02-0.08, so the band spans both ends. A value far above 0.20 would mean the blur is too large, which is how the blur error was caught.

quantity: frames where the dose servo runs out of output
ours: 81% of all frames; 100% above 32 cm, 0% below
note: Output must double every 4.2 cm of PMMA (AAPM Report 125 p.27; 4.21 cm measured on a Ziehm mobile C-arm, PMID 34196461), so a real unit runs out on thick patients. This checks the servo pins on the thick side of the ceiling and nowhere else.
After matching mean and standard deviation, so only the shape is compared.

quantity: noise power spectrum shape, log-log correlation
note: Radially averaged spectrum of the high-pass residual, normalised to unit power. This is the statistic a physics model should get right and a gain-and-gamma augmentation cannot, because it has no mechanism that varies with frequency.
Panels mined from published figures are 8-bit, JPEG compressed and windowed by someone else. Those without grain are excluded from the noise comparison rather than allowed to flatter it.
